crumbs.name: Knowledge Based Professions and their Future

sections.body: Deep research agents and landscape scans automate the early stages of literature review and evidence synthesis, from finding relevant work to mapping how papers, claims, models, tools, and books relate. The scope covers search strategy, source triage, claim extraction, and the assembly of a structured view of a field. On this site, the library of 135 research papers and 11,075 extracted claims gives such scans a concrete, traceable base. The work sits within the broader AI researcher toolkit but is aimed at professionals who need defensible summaries rather than raw model output.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.body: These agents run on retrieval pipelines that combine scholarly indexes, open repositories, and local structured libraries with document parsing, embedding, reranking, and long-context language models. They need access to full text where licences allow, and they often cache parsed papers and extracted claims for repeated queries. The site's catalogue of 804 scientific models and 732 AI tools is itself a landscape that a scan can treat as structured metadata. Compute is usually modest for a single scan but grows with the number of sources and the depth of claim extraction.
sections.heading: What it runs on

sections.body: A scan typically begins by decomposing a research question into subqueries, retrieving candidate papers, and filtering for relevance and quality. The agent then extracts individual claims, links each claim to its source, clusters related findings, and flags contradictions or gaps. On this site, content links to the original paper rather than a third-party search tool, so every extracted claim can be checked against the primary source. The 11,075 claims extracted from research works illustrate the granularity that a deep research agent is expected to produce.
sections.heading: How the work is done

sections.body: The main risks are hallucinated summaries, missed negative results, citation errors, and bias toward openly accessible or highly cited work. Provenance is the central control, and the site's practice of linking to the original paper supports an audit trail from claim to source. Copyright and licensing limits on full text also shape what an agent may store or quote. No part of a scan is treated as legal, financial, investment, or medical advice, and on medical topics the output does not direct a reader's own care.
sections.heading: Rights, risk and provenance

sections.body: Deep research agents are moving from one-off scans to continuously updated evidence maps that refresh as new papers, models, and tools appear. Better claim extraction and contradiction detection will let a scan show where findings agree, disagree, or remain untested. The site's 91 AI books and 674 glossary terms point toward a synthesis that goes beyond papers and includes longer-form and definitional sources. Over time, a landscape scan may become a living, queryable research graph rather than a static report.
